title: Convenient, clean, and super nice Townhome!
description:
Bring the whole family or just yourself, or you and a friend, friends, or couple to this great place with lots of room for fun.  Easy and short drive to the airport (15 minutes), downtown Nashville (25 minutes), shopping, Mt. Juliet (10 minutes) and historical sites (10 minutes).  So much to do and yet a great place for privacy and downtime during your stay in the Nashville area.

The space
Living room, Kitchen, half bath 1st floor, 3 bedrooms, master bathroom, full bathroom, washer/dryer upstairs.

Other things to note
No smoking and no pets are allowed on this premises.  
NOTE:  Temporary Wireless WIFI can be purchased for your stay through XFinity for $10 for 10 days.  Thank you.
